# Authorship and provenance

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

moddotplot-rs was written by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.
Adam Phillippy specified the scientific goals, estimator semantics, performance
priorities, interface behavior, validation requirements, and release policy, and
reviewed the resulting design through iterative development.

This is the canonical prose authorship statement. Other documents link here rather
than restating it, reducing the risk of attribution drift. Machine-readable authorship,
software version, preferred citation, and method references are maintained in
[`CITATION.cff`](../CITATION.cff).

The v0.1.0 baseline is preserved by Git tag `v0.1.0`; the current release candidate is
`v0.2.1`. Scientific tiles carry
a versioned configuration digest covering every estimator parameter that can affect
their numeric output. The browser displays the digest and principal parameters under
Advanced options. Release builds also include a CycloneDX SBOM, a dependency license
bundle, checksums, and build provenance.
